entries.quote: By 2025, the G2000 Will Allocate Over 40% of Core IT Spend to AI Initiatives, Leading to a Double-Digit Increase in the Rate of Product and Process Innovations
entries.subject: AI share of IT spend
entries.metric: share of G2000 core IT spend allocated to AI initiatives

entries.quote: With Tech Providers Allocating 50% of R&D, Staffing, and Capex Investments to AI/Automation Through 2026, CIOs Will Struggle to Align Vendor Selection and ITOps Priorities with New Use Cases
entries.subject: Tech provider AI investment
entries.metric: share of tech provider R&D, staffing and capex allocated to AI/automation

entries.quote: Into 2025, All Enterprises Will Deal with Uncertain Infrastructure Costs and Accessibility, Triggering the Use of Stop-Gap Measures That Make Cloud Economics and Data Logistics Goals Harder to Achieve
entries.subject: Infrastructure cost uncertainty
entries.note: No number; applies to all enterprises.

entries.quote: In 2024, Providers Across the Hardware, Software, and Services Spectrum Will Aggressively Expand Their Private and Open Source Data Portfolios, Making Strategic Partnering Decisions More Unstable
entries.subject: Provider data portfolios

entries.quote: Through 2026, the Underfunding of Skills Initiatives Compared with Products/Services Spend Will Prevent 65% of Enterprises from Achieving Full Value from AI, Cloud, Data, and Security Investments
entries.subject: Skills underfunding
entries.metric: share of enterprises prevented from achieving full value from AI, cloud, data and security

entries.quote: By 2025, 40% of Service Engagements Will Include GenAI-Enabled Delivery, Triggering a Shift in Human-Delivered Services for Strategy, Change, and Training to Prepare Organizations for AI Everywhere
entries.subject: GenAI-enabled services delivery
entries.metric: share of service engagements including GenAI-enabled delivery

entries.quote: In 2027, 80% of Infrastructure, Security, Data, and Apps Will Rely on Advanced Control Platforms for Coordinated AI-Enabled Service Delivery, But Only Half of Enterprises Will Use Them Effectively
entries.subject: AI-enabled control platforms
entries.metric: share of infrastructure, security, data and apps relying on advanced control platforms
entries.note: Also: only half of enterprises will use them effectively.

entries.quote: By 2026, All New IT Brands, Products, and Services Targeting Underserved Customer Segments/Personas Will Be Based on Tight Integration of Diverse AI Services That Deliver New Capabilities at Lower Costs
entries.subject: AI-integrated IT products
entries.metric: share of new IT brands/products for underserved segments based on integrated AI services

entries.quote: By 2027, 60% of F500 Firms Will Leverage Ubiquitous Experiences, Edge Analytics, and GenAI to Enable Customers to Create Their Own Experience Journeys, Improving Customer-Desired Outcomes and Values
entries.subject: Customer-created experience journeys
entries.metric: share of F500 firms enabling customers to create their own journeys

entries.quote: By 2028, 80% of Enterprises Will Integrate Low Earth Orbit Satellite Connectivity, Creating a Unified Digital Service Fabric That Ensures Resilient Ubiquitous Access and Guarantees Data Fluidity
entries.subject: LEO satellite connectivity
entries.metric: share of enterprises integrating LEO satellite connectivity

entries.quote: By 2028, 85% of CIOs Will Leverage Organizational Changes to Harness AI, Automation, and Analytics, Driving Agile, Insight-Driven Digital Businesses
entries.subject: Organizational change for AI
entries.metric: share of CIOs using organizational changes to harness AI, automation and analytics

entries.quote: By 2024, 65% of CIOs Will Face Pressure to Adopt Digital Tech Such as GenAI and Deep Intelligence, But limited IT Support Will Diminish the Benefits and Heighten Risks
entries.subject: GenAI adoption pressure
entries.metric: share of CIOs facing pressure to adopt GenAI and deep intelligence

entries.quote: By 2027, 75% of CIOs Will Integrate Cybersecurity Measures Directly into Systems and Processes to Proactively Detect and Neutralize Vulnerabilities, Fortifying Against Cyberthreats and Breaches
entries.subject: Embedded cybersecurity
entries.metric: share of CIOs integrating cybersecurity directly into systems and processes

entries.quote: By 2025, 45% of CIOs Will Prioritize Strategic Data Management and Foster a Data-Centric Culture, Ensuring Competitive Differentiation in the Digital Era
entries.subject: Strategic data management
entries.metric: share of CIOs prioritizing strategic data management

entries.quote: Two-Thirds of CIOs Will Not Meet Their 2025 Digital Revenue Goals Due to Misaligned Investments Hindering Business Performance
entries.subject: Digital revenue goals
entries.metric: share of CIOs not meeting 2025 digital revenue goals

entries.quote: 50% of CIOs Will Team Up with LOB Executives to Establish Robust Federated Governance for Cohesive AI Strategies, Driving Swift and Seamless GenAI Adoption in Worker Augmentation and Automation by 2026
entries.subject: Federated AI governance
entries.metric: share of CIOs establishing federated AI governance with LOB executives

entries.quote: By 2024, 35% of CIOs Will Embrace GenAI, Securing an Early Short-Term Advantage Over Competitors While Cultivating a Foundation of Talent, Experience, and Training Data
entries.subject: Early GenAI adoption

entries.quote: To Mitigate Legal Risks and Enhance Their Brand and Competitive Advantage, Nearly Half of CIOs Will Be Motivated to Automate Regulatory Compliance and ESG by 2025
entries.subject: Automated regulatory compliance and ESG
entries.metric: share of CIOs motivated to automate regulatory compliance and ESG

entries.quote: By 2026, 40% of CIOs Will Forge Unified Strategies with CMOs, Dismantling Silos of Customer Data to Enable the Delivery of Expected Engagement Within a Trusted Digital Experience
entries.subject: CIO-CMO customer data strategy
entries.metric: share of CIOs forging unified strategies with CMOs

entries.quote: By 2026, 55% of CIOs Will Leverage Business-Savvy In-House Developers and Tools That Use GenAI and Low Code/No Code, as They and LOB Developers Build Competitive Differentiation Through Custom Apps
entries.subject: GenAI and low-code development
entries.metric: share of CIOs leveraging in-house developers and GenAI/low-code tools
